testsuite.name: com.pizzora.backend.Phase2InfrastructureTest

testcase.name: health ready returns 200 HEALTHY when all dependencies are UP
health ready returns 200 DEGRADED when redis or minio is DOWN while postgres is UP
correlation id propagates and StatusPages emits unified error envelope
openapi endpoint returns valid OpenAPI 3_1 JSON
health ready returns 503 UNHEALTHY when postgres is DOWN
AppConfig parses jdbc, redis, and s3 endpoints from env
